Class UnitConverter

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.util.UnitConverter
public final class UnitConverter extends Object
Converts stored metric values (kg, cm) into whatever the user has chosen to see, and formats them for display.

Kept separate from any one screen because Settings, Profile, Analytics and the Dashboard all show weight and height, and the conversion factors should only be written down once. Missing values (zero or below, the LocalProfileStore default for an unfilled profile) format as "—" instead of "0.0 kg".

    • formatHeight

      public static String formatHeight(double centimetres, UnitSystem system)
      "180 cm" for metric, or feet and inches such as "5 ft 11 in" for imperial; "—" when no height has been entered.

      Imperial rounds to the nearest whole inch before splitting into feet, so 182.9 cm reads "6 ft 0 in" rather than the impossible "5 ft 12 in".
